newsitem.title: USA: HOT STOCKS HIGHLIGHTS - Earnings drive shares.
newsitem.headline: HOT STOCKS HIGHLIGHTS - Earnings drive shares.

text.p: COCA-COLA CO - posted second quarter earnings of $0.53 a share compared with $0.42 a share a year ago. Net operating revenues dropped to $5.08 billion from $5.29 billion. Down 9/16 to 70-5/16.

ASPECT TELECOMMUNICATIONS CORP - Reported second quarter earnings of $0.24 a per primary share compared with $0.18 a share a year ago. Revenues rose 28 percent to $93.5 million. Goldman Sachs downgraded the stock to market perform from market outperform. Down six to 20-1/4.
RAYCHEM CORP - posted fourth quarter earnings of $1.34 a share compared with $1.05 a share a year ago. Merrill Lynch upgraded the stock to near-term outperform from neutral. Up 12-12/16 to 89-7/16.
TRIQUINT SEMICONDUCTOR INC - posted second quarter earnings of $0.25 a share compared with $0.21 a share. Revenues rose 23 percent. Down 7-1/8 to 37-1/16.
MERCK AND CO INC - Second quarter earnings rose to $0.96 a share from $0.80 a share, while sales increased 20 percent. Up 4-1/4 to 102-3/4.
PHYSIO-CONTROL HOLDING CORP - Second quarter earnings dropped to $0.17 a share from $0.22 a share as narrower margins and higher expenses offset higher revenues. Down 3-1/4 to 12-3/4.

SANDISK CORP - posted second quarter earnings of $0.15 a share compared with $0.14 a share. Revenues rose 11 percent. Sandisk also said if current trends continue, it is optimistic that the second half of the fiscal year will show improved results compared to the first half of this year. Up three to 24-1/4.
WESTERN MICRO TECHNOLOGY INC - expects second quarter earnings to fall short of last year's results and below the company's previous expectations. Off one to 9-5/8.
SCHLUMBERGER LTD - reported second quarter earnings of $0.62 a share compared with $0.40 a share last year. Revenues rose to $2.62 billion from $2.17 billion. Up 1-8/16 to 76-7/16.
RUBBERMAID INC - Posted second quarter earnings of $0.31 a share, including special items, compared with $0.30 a share last year. Down 2-9/16 to 27-3/4.
SEARS, ROEBUCK CO - reported second quarter operating earnings of $0.78 a share compared with $0.67 a share last year. Revenues rose to $9.73 billion compared with $9.13 billion. Up 2-1/8 to 58-5/8.
MCDONALD'S CORP - posted an increase in second quarter earnings and revenues, but said same-store sales were "slightly negative" during the quarter. Up 14/16 to 50-15/16.
HASBRO INC - second quarter earnings rose to $0.10 a share on revenues of $583.9 million, up from $0.05 a share on revenues of $511.6 million a year ago. Up 1/4 to 29-3/4.

SPRINT CORP - posted second quarter earnings of $0.59 a share, which fell below analysts' expectations and last year's results. Revenues increased to $3.68 billion from $3.48 billion a year ago. Down 1/4 to 46.
